annotations.title: The Sauna: strip prompt injections, secrets and PII from untrusted input

description:
Strips prompt-injection attempts, jailbreak payloads, PII, secrets, and encoding artifacts from untrusted input. Returns cleansed content and a report of what was removed. We never store what we strip.

Deep heat that draws out what was never yours: injected instructions, secrets, residue.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
